name: CISSP Certification Preparation
certifications: ISC2 Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Associate of ISC2 for those without the experience requirement
A path toward CCSP, CISM and CISSP concentrations

beginner.summary: For security practitioners starting CISSP study. Covers the exam and the eight domains, the manager mindset, security and risk management including governance, law, ethics and risk, business continuity planning, asset security and data protection, secure design principles and security models, cryptography and public key infrastructure, physical security, secure network design and protocols, identity and access management concepts and models, security assessment concepts and security operations concepts, with exam-style practice throughout. Built to the current ISC2 CISSP exam outline.
prerequisites: Has a few years of security or IT experience
Understands basic security concepts across several areas
Plans to pursue the CISSP or Associate of ISC2
outcomes: Explain the eight domains and the exam format
Apply the risk and governance concepts the exam rewards
Describe secure design, cryptography, network and identity fundamentals at CISSP depth
Answer exam-style questions with the manager mindset

days.topic: CISSP Overview: The Eight Domains and the Exam
subtopics: What the CISSP is and who it is for
The ISC2 experience requirement and Associate of ISC2
The eight domains and their weights
Questions from 100 to 150 in three hours
Course project overview: a personal exam readiness plan
days.lab_task: Build a personal study plan that maps the eight domains to weeks, sets a target exam date and schedules practice questions.
checks: Each domain has study time by weight
A realistic exam date is set

days.topic: Thinking Like a Manager for the Exam
subtopics: Why the exam rewards the manager view
Choosing the best answer, not the only correct one
The value of human life first
days.lab_task: Answer ten exam-style questions, then re-answer any you missed using the manager mindset and record why the best answer wins.
checks: Missed questions are reframed with the mindset
Why the best answer wins is explained

days.topic: Security and Risk Management: Concepts and Governance
days.lab_task: Draft a short governance structure for a company with policies, roles and a control framework, and explain due care and due diligence with examples.
checks: Due care and due diligence are explained
objectives: Apply due care and due diligence

days.topic: Security and Risk Management: Law, Regulation and Ethics
subtopics: Law and ethics on the exam
days.lab_task: Map a scenario company's legal, privacy and contractual duties and resolve an ethical dilemma against the ISC2 code of ethics.
checks: Legal and privacy duties are mapped
The ethical dilemma is resolved correctly
objectives: Use the ISC2 code of ethics

days.topic: Security and Risk Management: Assessing and Treating Risk
subtopics: Quantitative risk: single and annual loss expectancy
days.lab_task: Calculate single and annual loss expectancy for a scenario, choose risk treatments and record residual risk in a register.
checks: Residual risk and acceptance are recorded

days.topic: Security and Risk Management: Business Continuity Planning
days.lab_task: Run a business impact analysis for a scenario service, set recovery objectives and outline a continuity strategy.
checks: Critical functions and impact are identified

days.topic: Asset Security: Classification and Ownership
days.lab_task: Build a classification scheme for a scenario company, assign ownership roles and define handling rules by classification level.
checks: Owner, custodian and user roles are assigned

days.topic: Asset Security: Data Handling and Privacy
subtopics: Data at rest, in transit and in use
days.lab_task: Choose protection for each data state in a scenario, define retention and destruction rules and a sanitisation method for retired media.
checks: Retention and destruction rules are set

days.topic: Security Architecture and Engineering: Secure Design Principles
subtopics: Least privilege and separation of duties
Trust but verify and zero trust
days.lab_task: Apply secure design principles to a scenario system and run a simple threat model that shows where each principle helps.
days.deliverable: Secure design with a threat model
checks: Principles are applied to the design

days.topic: Security Architecture and Engineering: Security Models and Evaluation
subtopics: Trusted computing base and reference monitor
days.lab_task: Match scenario requirements to the right security model and explain what Bell-LaPadula and Biba each enforce.
checks: Requirements map to the right model

days.topic: Cryptography Essentials for the Exam
days.lab_task: Choose cryptographic methods for confidentiality, integrity and authenticity in a scenario and explain why each fits.
checks: Symmetric and asymmetric uses are explained

days.topic: Public Key Infrastructure and Key Management
subtopics: Public key infrastructure on the exam
days.lab_task: Describe a public key infrastructure for a scenario company including trust model, issuance and revocation, and a key management lifecycle.
checks: The certificate and key lifecycle are covered

days.topic: Physical Security Controls
days.lab_task: Design physical security for a scenario data centre with perimeter, access and environmental controls and justify each layer.
checks: Environmental and power controls are included

days.topic: Communication and Network Security: Secure Network Design
days.lab_task: Design a segmented secure network for a scenario company mapped to the OSI model, and explain the control at each layer.
checks: Controls map to the OSI layers
The network is segmented into zones

days.topic: Communication and Network Security: Secure Protocols and Components
subtopics: Voice, multimedia and remote collaboration security
Protocols and components on the exam
days.lab_task: Choose secure protocols and network components for a scenario and explain how firewalls and intrusion prevention fit the design.
checks: Firewalls and intrusion prevention are placed well

days.topic: Identity and Access Management: Key Concepts
days.lab_task: Map the identity lifecycle for a scenario and choose authentication methods for users of different risk levels.
checks: Federation and single sign-on are explained

days.topic: Identity and Access Management: Access Control Models
subtopics: Least privilege and need to know
Access control models on the exam
days.lab_task: Match access control models to scenario needs and design role-based access with least privilege for one system.
checks: An access review approach is described

days.topic: Security Assessment and Testing: Approaches
subtopics: Code review and testing in brief
days.lab_task: Plan an assessment programme for a scenario with the right mix of vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and audits, and explain each choice.
checks: The mix of tests fits the scenario
Each test type's purpose is explained

days.topic: Security Operations: Core Concepts
subtopics: Separation of duties and job rotation
days.lab_task: Outline core security operations for a scenario including monitoring, incident response and change management, and explain separation of duties.
checks: The incident response lifecycle is described

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Eight-Domain Readiness Review
days.lab_task: Take a mixed practice set across the eight domains, score it by domain, identify weak areas and update the study plan.
checks: A mixed practice set is scored by domain

intermediate.summary: For CISSP candidates deepening each domain. Covers security governance programmes, threat modelling and supply chain risk, personnel and awareness, asset handling and data lifecycle, secure systems and vulnerabilities across platforms, cloud and virtualisation security, cryptographic systems and attacks, network attacks and defences, wireless and remote access, identity management systems and federation, authorisation mechanisms, assessment and testing programmes, operations and incident management, software development security, and domain-by-domain exam practice with the manager mindset.
prerequisites: Has CISSP beginner knowledge or equivalent across the domains
Works in security and understands controls
Is preparing for the CISSP exam
outcomes: Apply each domain at CISSP depth to scenarios
Analyse threats, cryptography, networks and identity at the exam level
Explain software development and operations security
Answer harder domain questions and track readiness

days.topic: Security Governance and Programme Management
subtopics: Security roles and the reporting line
days.lab_task: Design a security programme for a scenario company with governance, metrics and a reporting line, and justify the choices to leadership.

days.topic: Threat Modelling and Supply Chain Risk Management
days.lab_task: Run a STRIDE threat model for a scenario system and assess a key supplier against minimum security requirements.
checks: The supplier is assessed for risk

days.topic: Personnel Security and Security Awareness
days.lab_task: Design personnel security controls for a scenario across the employment lifecycle and outline an awareness programme with measures.

days.topic: Asset Handling and the Data Lifecycle
days.lab_task: Map the full data lifecycle for a scenario and define handling, retention and destruction controls for each stage.
checks: Retention and legal hold are defined

days.topic: Secure Systems and Vulnerabilities Across Platforms
days.lab_task: Identify vulnerabilities across several platform types in a scenario and recommend mitigations for the highest risks.

days.topic: Cloud and Virtualisation Security
days.lab_task: Design cloud security controls for a scenario workload across the shared responsibility split and explain the virtualisation risks.

days.topic: Cryptographic Systems and Attacks in Depth
days.lab_task: Design the cryptography for a scenario application end to end and analyse it for two realistic cryptographic attacks.

days.topic: Network Attacks and Defences in Depth
subtopics: Denial of service and distributed denial of service
days.lab_task: Analyse a scenario network for likely attacks and design layered defences that reduce the risk of each.

days.topic: Wireless, Mobile and Remote Access Security
subtopics: Wireless and remote on the exam
days.lab_task: Design secure wireless and remote access for a scenario workforce including mobile management and remote work controls.

days.topic: Identity Management Systems and Federation
subtopics: Federation with SAML and OpenID Connect
Credential and session management at scale
days.lab_task: Design an identity management system for a scenario with provisioning, single sign-on and federation, and explain the trust relationships.
checks: Provisioning and single sign-on are defined

days.topic: Authorisation Mechanisms and Accountability
days.lab_task: Design authorisation and accountability for a scenario system with attribute-based rules and an access certification process.

days.topic: Security Assessment and Testing Programmes
days.lab_task: Design an assessment and testing programme for a scenario with cadence, control testing and management review, and plan remediation tracking.
checks: The programme covers the needed tests

days.topic: Security Operations and Incident Management in Depth
days.lab_task: Take a scenario incident through the full incident management lifecycle with evidence handling and recovery, and capture lessons learned.

days.topic: Software Development Security
days.lab_task: Map security activities to each phase of the software development lifecycle for a scenario and identify the top software risks and controls.
checks: Security activities map to each phase

days.topic: Assessing Software Security and Acquired Software
days.lab_task: Assess a scenario application that mixes custom and third-party code and recommend controls for the highest software risks.
checks: Custom and third-party code are assessed

days.topic: Domain Deep Dive Practice: Risk, Asset and Architecture
days.lab_task: Take a timed practice set on the risk, asset and architecture domains, review every miss and track weak subtopics.

days.topic: Domain Deep Dive Practice: Network, Identity and Assessment
days.lab_task: Take a timed practice set on the network, identity and assessment domains, review every miss and update the weak-area tracker.

days.topic: Domain Deep Dive Practice: Operations and Software Security
days.lab_task: Take a timed practice set on the operations and software security domains, review misses and update the weak-area tracker.

days.topic: Connecting the Domains: Cross-Domain Scenarios
subtopics: Applying the manager mindset across domains
days.lab_task: Work through cross-domain scenario questions, identify which domains each touches and explain the best answer across domains.
checks: The best answer is chosen across domains

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Full-Length Practice Exam and Review
days.lab_task: Take a full-length timed practice exam, score it by domain, analyse weak areas and update the study plan toward the real exam.
days.deliverable: Full practice exam result and plan
checks: A full-length exam is completed in time

advanced.summary: For candidates in the final stretch and for those applying CISSP knowledge as managers. Covers advanced governance and risk leadership, enterprise security architecture, zero trust and secure design at scale, advanced cryptography and public key infrastructure, network and cloud security architecture, identity architecture, security assessment leadership, security operations leadership, secure software leadership, privacy and emerging technology, exam strategy and adaptive testing, high-difficulty practice by domain, cross-domain mastery, a final readiness review and endorsement and the path beyond CISSP.
prerequisites: Has studied all eight domains at intermediate depth
Scores near passing on practice exams
Is close to sitting the CISSP exam
outcomes: Apply CISSP knowledge as a security leader across the domains
Handle the hardest scenario questions with the manager mindset
Master exam strategy for the adaptive test
Confirm readiness and plan endorsement and next steps

days.topic: Advanced Governance and Risk Leadership
days.lab_task: For a scenario, set risk appetite, align a security strategy and present an investment decision with risk justification to a board persona.
checks: Risk appetite and tolerance are set
Strategy aligns with risk and business

days.topic: Designing Enterprise Security Architecture
days.lab_task: Design an enterprise security architecture for a scenario organisation and defend its control choices against business and risk needs.

days.topic: Zero Trust and Secure Design at Scale
subtopics: Zero trust at the enterprise level
days.lab_task: Build a phased zero trust strategy for a scenario enterprise and show how secure design principles apply at scale.

days.topic: Advanced Cryptography and Public Key Infrastructure
days.lab_task: Design enterprise cryptography and key management for a scenario, including public key infrastructure and a post-quantum readiness plan.
checks: Key management and public key infrastructure are defined

days.topic: Network and Cloud Security Architecture
subtopics: Network and cloud architecture on the exam
days.lab_task: Design network and cloud security architecture for a scenario hybrid estate and justify segmentation and access choices.
checks: The architecture covers network and cloud

days.topic: Identity Architecture and Governance
subtopics: Federation and single sign-on at scale
days.lab_task: Design enterprise identity architecture for a scenario with federation, privileged access and governance, and review it for weaknesses.

days.topic: Security Assessment and Testing Leadership
subtopics: Managing penetration tests and red teams
days.lab_task: Design an assessment strategy for a scenario enterprise, coordinate independent testing and plan leadership reporting and remediation governance.

days.topic: Security Operations Leadership
days.lab_task: Design security operations leadership for a scenario including incident command, metrics and continuity, and present it to leadership.
checks: Operations strategy and command are defined

days.topic: Secure Software Development Leadership
days.lab_task: Design a secure software development programme for a scenario organisation with governance, enablement and metrics.
checks: The programme covers lifecycle and culture

days.topic: Privacy, Emerging Technology and the Future
subtopics: Internet of things and operational technology
days.lab_task: Assess privacy and two emerging technologies for a scenario organisation and recommend governance and controls for each.
checks: Privacy duties and emerging risks are assessed
Governance for AI or similar is recommended

days.topic: Exam Strategy and the Adaptive Test
subtopics: Why questions get harder or easier
When to commit to an answer
The day before and the day of
days.lab_task: Take a timed adaptive-style practice set, practise pacing and distractor elimination and record a personal exam-day strategy.
checks: A personal exam-day strategy is written
objectives: Describe how the adaptive test works

days.topic: High-Difficulty Practice: Security and Risk, Asset and Architecture
days.lab_task: Take a high-difficulty practice set on these three domains, review every miss deeply and close one weak subtopic.
checks: A hard set is completed in time

days.topic: High-Difficulty Practice: Networking, Identity and Testing
days.lab_task: Take a high-difficulty practice set on these three domains, review every miss deeply and close one weak subtopic.
checks: A hard set is completed in time

days.topic: High-Difficulty Practice: Operations and Development Security
days.lab_task: Take a high-difficulty practice set on these two domains, review every miss deeply and close one weak subtopic.
checks: A hard set is completed in time

days.topic: Cross-Domain Mastery and Scenario Judgement
days.lab_task: Work through long cross-domain scenarios, justify the best answer for each and explain the judgement used.
checks: The best answer is chosen under ambiguity
Life safety and risk guide priorities

days.topic: Second Full-Length Practice Exam and Analysis
days.lab_task: Take a second full-length timed exam, compare domain scores with the first, analyse remaining gaps and make a go-or-wait decision.
checks: The exam is completed in time
Progress since the first exam is shown

days.topic: Final Readiness Review and Weak-Area Closure
days.lab_task: Close your top weak areas with targeted review and recall practice, and complete a final readiness checklist.

days.topic: Endorsement, Continuing Education and Beyond CISSP
subtopics: Related certifications such as CCSP and CISM
days.lab_task: Plan your endorsement, continuing education and next certification after CISSP and write a personal development plan.
checks: A next step after CISSP is chosen

days.topic: Applying Frameworks: NIST, ISO and COBIT for Leaders
subtopics: NIST risk management and control catalogues
Using frameworks in the exam mindset
days.lab_task: Map a scenario organisation's needs to the right frameworks, cross-map a set of controls and explain how a leader would use them together.
checks: How a leader uses them is explained

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Exam Readiness and a Security Leadership Scenario
days.lab_task: Confirm exam readiness from your practice results, then work a security leadership scenario that spans several domains and justify every decision with the manager mindset.
checks: Scenario decisions are justified across domains
Endorsement and next steps are planned
